_meta.title: Private Floor Club verification benchmark - batch 7 cases
_meta.groundTruthNote: GROUND TRUTH TO BE CONFIRMED BY RICHARD. Batch 7 (2026-10-26). Pairings checked current via free web search 2026-10-26 (linkSource). B7R01 tests EDGAR on a large public REIT (Vornado Realty Trust CIK 899689; 'Realty Trust' generic tokens). B7R02 is the US arm of a foreign GC (Skanska AB is not an SEC filer; 'USA' generic token must not match an unrelated filer). B7R03 is a national brokerage with a per-person bio page (avisonyoung.us/w/james-nelson). B7R04 tests law-firm bio crawl on paulweiss.com (/professionals/partners-and-counsel/harris-b-freidus, HTTP 200 to curl). B7R05 is a private lender/investment manager (MREG is not an SEC filer; affiliate Claros Mortgage Trust CMTG is; 'Group' generic token); mackregroup.com has no team page. Websites and LinkedIn company slugs confirmed by HTTP 200 + page title on 2026-10-26 (Paul Weiss slug without '&' to avoid the known batch-3 '&' bug). B7F01 is invented (domain NXDOMAIN via dns.google; LinkedIn profile does not exist; 0 EDGAR full-text hits for 'pembury'/'kettleworth').

defaults.statement: I invest in and operate commercial and residential real estate and would like to meet other owners and operators.

_meta.emailPolicy: Every case uses a Gmail address (except F02 which is a disposable mailinator address on purpose) so the email domain carries no signal. Nothing is ever sent to these addresses.
